message.boundary: Conversation-resource message permits assistant. Do not confuse it with input-message schema, which permits user/system/developer only.

reasoning.summary: Array of summary_text items, each requiring type and text strings.
reasoning.content: Array of reasoning_text items, each requiring type and text strings.
reasoning.encrypted_content: Opaque string or null; no claim it supplies observable input accounting.

configuration_update.reasoning: Object with optional effort, a nullable documented enum: none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max.
configuration_update.effect: Changes response reasoning configuration until replaced. No agent_reference, instructions or tools property is documented on this item.
configuration_update.admission: Reject this item in the initial fixed-configuration profile. Its existence is documented; runtime configuration changes are not enabled by this application.

historyAdmissionProfile.state: Pinned offline subset; implementation belongs to the managed history task and private compatibility remains a release gate.
historyAdmissionProfile.messages: Accept separately documented message (user/assistant only) and output_message (assistant only); require id, completed status and content array. Do not rewrite type or role.
historyAdmissionProfile.text: User input_text and assistant output_text require text strings. Assistant annotations/logprobs must be absent or empty; refusal is terminal, never reusable success. Phase, when present, is commentary or final_answer.
historyAdmissionProfile.functions: Require id/type/call_id/name/arguments for calls and id/type/call_id/output for results. Arguments and output are strings validated by the pinned workload schemas; result correlation is mandatory. Caller absent/null/direct only, namespace absent, async absent/false, status absent/completed.
historyAdmissionProfile.reasoning: Only documented summary_text and reasoning_text arrays; encrypted_content absent/null only. Reject opaque data rather than treating a summary as complete observable history.
historyAdmissionProfile.configurationUpdates: Reject; never ignore, strip or replay a changed configuration.
historyAdmissionProfile.closedShapes: Unknown fields/types/content, duplicate keys/IDs, uncorrelated outputs and edited workload content fail closed. No ignored opaque fields.
historyAdmissionProfile.failure: conversation_history_invalid; retire, suppress output and queue cleanup before any subsequent submission.
historyAdmissionProfile.accounting: Count exact validated observable history and identifiers plus manifest instructions/tools/configuration; no claim to account for invisible service inference.

documentedItemTypeCandidates.state: Missing configuration schema found in current official Microsoft reference. Context-specific message and optional service call_id distinctions resolve static blockers without broadening the admitted application subset.
